List-I (Religious Teachers):
(A) Appar, Sambandar, Sundaramurti
(B) Kabir, Raidas, Surdas
(C) Sri Chaitanya
(D) Mirabai, Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti

List-II (Area of Influence):
(I) Tamil Nadu
(II) Uttar Pradesh
(III) Rajasthan
(IV) Bengal

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Matching analysis:
- (A) Appar, Sambandar, Sundaramurti are revered Tamil Shaivite Nayanars whose hymns form the Tevaram -> (I) Tamil Nadu.
- (B) Kabir, Raidas (Ravidas), and Surdas composed in Brajbhasha/Hindustani in the Gangetic plain -> (II) Uttar Pradesh.
- (C) Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu propagated Krishna bhakti and sankirtana -> (IV) Bengal.
- (D) Mirabai was a Rajput princess of Mewar/Merta and Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti founded the Chishti silsila at Ajmer -> (III) Rajasthan.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.

(A) Shaikh Nasiruddin Chiragh-i Dehli
(B) Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti
(C) Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya
(D) Shaikh Fariduddin Ganj-i Shakar
